items.headline: EUDR seen as major compliance driver for traders
items.summary: Industry analysts argue the EU Deforestation Regulation is becoming more than an environmental rule, pushing commodity traders toward tighter supply-chain data and CTRM integration, according to CTRM Center commentary.

items.headline: Tether expands into commodity trade lending
items.summary: Stablecoin issuer Tether Holdings has moved into commodity trade finance, reportedly extending roughly $1.5 billion in credit to traders with plans to scale further, per ICC trade finance reporting.

items.headline: EMIR Phase II reconciliation reaches UK regime
items.summary: Phase II trade repository reconciliation, already live under EU EMIR since April, is scheduled to begin under UK EMIR this September, adding dozens of new data-matching fields for reporting firms to manage.

items.headline: Hormuz tensions squeeze commodity shipping routes
items.summary: Attacks on shipping in the Middle East pushed Brent above $105 a barrel, with vessel-tracking data showing sharply reduced tanker transits through the Strait of Hormuz and continued pressure near the Red Sea corridor.
